title: Curtains for a Rented Apartment in Kuwait
description: Curtain options for renters in Kuwait: what to choose when you cannot add a gypsum pocket, roller blinds versus wave curtains, and real prices per metre.
imageAlt: White roller blind in a bathroom window in Kuwait
body:
Most rented apartments in Kuwait come with bare windows or old curtains. You may not be allowed to change the ceiling, and you may move in a year or two. Here is how to cover the windows sensibly.

No gypsum work needed

A hidden track needs a gypsum pocket in the ceiling. In a rental you usually cannot add one, so we fix the track directly to the ceiling or above the window. A wave curtain on a ceiling track still looks neat.

Roller blinds for bathrooms, kitchens and small rooms

Roller blinds fit inside the window frame, take little space and cost 8 KWD per square metre. A 1.2 × 1.4 m window is 1.68 m², about 13.4 KWD.

Wave curtains for the living room and bedroom

  • Single layer: 12 KWD per linear metre of track.
  • Fabric plus sheer on a double track: 19 KWD per linear metre.
  • Blackout fabric for bedrooms that face the sun.

Before you order

  • Ask your landlord whether drilling into the ceiling is allowed.
  • Installation is free for 5 curtains or more; otherwise 5 KWD per curtain.
  • We only install curtains we make ourselves.

See all prices on the curtain prices page.

faqs.question: Can I take the curtains with me when I move?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wave curtains and roller blinds can be taken down and refitted if the new window is a similar size.

faqs.question: Do you need to drill?
faqs.answer: Yes, the track or blind bracket is screwed into the ceiling or wall. Check with your landlord first.

faqs.question: Is the home visit free?
faqs.answer: Yes, measuring and showing samples is free, except in Abdali and Subiya where the visit is paid.

title: Vertical Blinds for Offices in Kuwait
description: Vertical blinds for Kuwait offices: how the slats control glare on screens, when they beat roller blinds on wide glass, and the price at 12 KWD per m².
imageAlt: Grey vertical blinds installed in a Kuwait office
body:
Vertical blinds are fabric slats hanging from a top track. One cord turns the slats to angle the light; another draws them all to one side. They are a common choice for offices with wide glass.

Why offices choose them

  • Glare control: turning the slats cuts sun on screens without closing the room off.
  • Wide glass: one blind can cover a long window or sliding door, where a roller would need several pieces.
  • Easy cleaning: slats can be wiped or removed individually.

Vertical, roller or zebra?

  • Vertical blinds: 12 KWD per m², best for wide glass and sliding doors.
  • Roller blinds: 8 KWD per m², best for standard windows.
  • Zebra blinds: 9 KWD per m², gradual light control.

Worked example

An office window 3 m wide and 2 m high is 6 m². At 12 KWD per m² the vertical blind costs 72 KWD. Installation is free for 5 blinds or more.

For more office options see office blinds and commercial curtains.

faqs.question: How is the price calculated?
faqs.answer: Width × height in metres × 12 KWD per square metre, including fabric, track and tailoring.

faqs.question: Do you measure on site?
faqs.answer: Yes, we visit the office, measure every window and send one quote.

faqs.question: Can the slats be replaced?
faqs.answer: Individual slats can be removed for cleaning; ask us about replacements for blinds we made.

title: Curtains for Villas with Double-Height Windows
description: How to dress double-height windows in Kuwait villas: wave curtains from the ceiling, double tracks with sheer, motorised options and how they are measured.
imageAlt: Beige wave curtains with sheer on a tall villa window in Hawalli
body:
Many Kuwait villas have a double-height living room or stair window. These windows let in a lot of sun and are hard to reach, so the curtain has to solve both.

Wave curtains from the ceiling

A wave curtain on a ceiling track covers the full height in one drop. With a double track you get fabric for privacy at night and sheer for daylight. See a project gallery of tall windows we have fitted.

Heat from the sun

Tall glass facing south or west heats the room. Blackout fabric on the sun side reduces that heat.

Motorised option

When the track is too high to pull by hand comfortably, a motor and remote make daily use easy. You need a power point near the end of the track, ideally prepared before the gypsum work.

Measuring

  • We measure from the ceiling to the floor at several points.
  • Tell us the ceiling height so the team brings the right ladder.

Prices

  • Single wave: 12 KWD per linear metre.
  • Wave with sheer: 19 KWD per linear metre.

faqs.question: Can one curtain cover a 6 m high window?
faqs.answer: We tailor the drop to the measured height; tell us the height so we can confirm the fabric and track.

faqs.question: Do motorised curtains need wiring?
faqs.answer: Yes, a power point near the track end.

faqs.question: Is installation included?
faqs.answer: Installation is free for 5 curtains or more; otherwise 5 KWD per curtain.

title: How to Measure Your Windows for Curtains
description: Step-by-step guide to measuring windows for curtains and blinds in Kuwait: width, drop, inside or outside mount, and why we take the final measurements.
imageAlt: Grey roller blinds fitted inside three windows
body:
You can measure your windows yourself to get an early price on WhatsApp. The final measurements are taken by our team on the free home visit.

What you need

A steel tape measure and a phone to photograph each window.

Fabric curtains (wave)

  • Width: measure the wall or the area the track will cover, not only the glass. Add space on both sides so light does not leak.
  • Drop: from the ceiling (or track position) to the floor.

Roller, zebra and roman blinds

  • Inside the frame: measure the opening width at top, middle and bottom and use the smallest.
  • Outside the frame: add a margin on each side so the blind overlaps the opening.

Turning measurements into a price

  • Wave: track length × 12 KWD (single) or × 19 KWD (with sheer).
  • Roller blind: width × height × 8 KWD.
  • Zebra: width × height × 9 KWD.

See the full list on the prices page, or browse custom curtains.

faqs.question: Do I need to measure before the visit?
faqs.answer: No. Measuring yourself only helps with an early estimate.

faqs.question: Should I measure the glass or the frame?
faqs.answer: For fabric curtains, measure the wall area to cover; for blinds inside the frame, measure the opening.

faqs.question: Is the visit free?
faqs.answer: Yes, except in Abdali and Subiya where it is paid.
